spec: Indexed radix heap (Ahuja-Mehlhorn-Orlin-Tarjan) for monotone 64-bit unsigned keys: 65 buckets by bit width of key XOR last-popped key, intrusive doubly-linked lists over a node pool allocated once, decrease-key by bucket move, rejection of keys below the last popped key, comparisons counted only for bucket-minimum search

tests: radix heap pops monotone 64-bit keys in order
radix heap decrease-key moves an item to a lower bucket
radix heap accepts keys equal to the last popped key (zero-weight edges)
radix heap enforces monotonicity and rejects invalid operations
radix heap handles the full 64-bit key range
radix heap counts comparisons only when searching a bucket minimum
radix heap matches the reference model under monotone keys
